title: Development of a logic regression-based approach for the discovery of host- and niche-informative biomarkers in Escherichia coli and their application for microbial source tracking
summary: Logic regression discovers host- and niche-informative E. coli sequence biomarkers and applies them to classify environmental-water isolates. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.

evidence.tested: Logic regression discovers host- and niche-informative E. coli sequence biomarkers and applies them to classify environmental-water isolates.
evidence.unknown: No prospective clinical benefit or broader external validity is established by the documented study.
evidence.ai_role: The study analyzes host-associated sequence variation, builds logic models, and applies repeated model fits to water isolates of unknown source.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
